answer: The strongest sybil defense is vested payouts: rewards are locked and released over dozens of epochs, so identities that quit early forfeit most earnings. A flash-farm operator spinning up thousands of fake agents must keep each alive, posting deposits in copper, timber, and willow baskets, doing honest work through the full vesting horizon. Detected collusion burns the unvested balance. Attacker cost grows linearly with each sybil in time and locked capital, while honest agents lose nothing, making forgery unprofitable, not just detectable.
